verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork supports scheduled recurring tasks that run automatically on a set cadence or on demand (claude-docs-5, claude-docs-38), which is a form of automation, but this is time/schedule-based rather than true event-driven rule triggers (e.g., 'when X happens, do Y' from external events like emails, webhooks, file changes). No evidence shows Claude supporting arbitrary event-based trigger rules beyond scheduling. Missing for 10: documented event-trigger/webhook-based automation rules, evidence of triggering on external events (not just time schedules), and any rule-definition UI for conditional automation.
